versions.content: The attribute CouplingPortDetails.defaultTrafficClass defines a default traffic class for the CouplingPort which owns the CouplingPortDetails. The defaultTrafficClass is applied when a frame is processed at the Coupling- Port and there is no CouplingPortTrafficClassAssignment.priority de- fined for the frame’s priority in the CouplingPortDetails.ethernetTraffic- ClassAssignment.

The attribute CouplingPortDetails.defaultTrafficClass defines a default traffic class for the CouplingPort which owns the CouplingPortDetails . The defaultTrafficClass is applied when a frame is processed at the CouplingPort and there is no CouplingPortTrafficClassAssignment.priority defined for the frame’s priority in the CouplingPortDetails.ethernetTrafficClassAs- signment .
